name: Jellyfin Enhanced
overview: Jellyfin Enhanced and Jellyfin Elsewhere for a better Jellyfin experience.
description: A combination of the Jellyfin Enhanced and Jellyfin Elsewhere userscripts, providing a comprehensive set of tweaks and features for Jellyfin.

versions.changelog:
**Fork build for Jellyfin 12.**

- fix(extras): hide watching avatars on a hovered card so Jellyfin's card buttons can be clicked

**Fork build for Jellyfin 10.11.**

- fix(extras): hide watching avatars on a hovered card so Jellyfin's card buttons can be clicked

**Fork build for Jellyfin 12.**

- ci(fork): build releases and a plugin manifest for installing this fork from Jellyfin
- feat(extras): show who is watching as live avatars on posters
- feat(reclaimerr): approve a deletion request for later, with Reclaimerr's grace period, now, or a chosen day
- fix(admintags): Media Tags confirmations no longer rebuild the configuration page (#1090)
- perf: lighter Home screen with lazy feature bundles and cheaper tags (#1088)
- feat(leaving-soon): request-style cards, sizes, and sturdier Reclaimerr request handling (#1089)
- docs(api): document reclaimerr/create-users and bump the route total to 224
- fix(activity): show season and episode for episodes in Active Streams
- chore(tests): regenerate production inventory
- feat(reclaimerr): create Reclaimerr accounts for Jellyfin users and show a person's own removal requests
- docs: Open in Jellyfin page, docs restructure, and move the build to Zensical (#1086)
- perf(tags): write the quality chip base CSS once instead of once per quality colour (374 KB to 26 KB)
- fix(seerr): Filters pill and Series tab under Jellyfish, Zesty and JellyFlix themes (#1085)
- feat(seerr): filters on Recommendations, filters in the page address, all or any, Without genres and language, saved filters (#1084)
- fix(admin): keep Media Tags deep links when the address follows the open tab, update api.md route total and in-place link test
- fix(seerr): let the discovery section span the full width on themes that grid .detailSection
- chore(tests): regenerate production inventory
- feat(admin): analytics icon on reported settings and tab/card in the config page address
- fix(tests): update api.md route total and config flag groups for leaving soon
- fix(seerr): keep the region in the search language so TMDB returns the right regional titles (#1082)
